portalsFound.observation: Official public BhuNaksha viewer; Pathankot district code 21 and Pathankot tehsil code 093 were discoverable through the viewer's own REST routes.
Official Pathankot district portal links to Punjab Land Records and identifies the district administration.
Official municipal draft cadastral map PDF; map image only, with an information-only disclaimer.
Official Punjab Land Records cadastral-map page; village-wise selection UI, no vector API exposed in the page result.

remainingUncertainty: The viewer proves public institutional custody and an anonymous plot lookup, but the current public route did not expose a safe vector polygon response or an explicitly declared CRS. The single selected village is not evidence of complete Pathankot city coverage. No inference is made from the exact WUP point, map extent, raster-only response, or lack of a vector endpoint.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently assess whether a sanctioned vector or geometry-capable adapter exists behind the current viewer; do not use the owner-bearing ScalarDatahandler payload for runtime integration.
